title: A New Framework for Evaluating Faithfulness of Video Moment Retrieval against Multiple Distractors

task_scope.task_family: video moment retrieval / video temporal grounding
task_scope.why_in_or_out: The task explicitly localizes query-relevant temporal moments or highlights.

evidence.quote: # Abstract With the explosion of multimedia content, video moment retrieval (VMR), which aims to detect a video moment that matches a given text query from a video, has been studied intensively as a critical problem.

background_setup.summary: # Introduction Enabled by the increased accessibility of video-sharing platforms along with the advancement of networking and storage technology, a vast amount of new content becomes available on the web daily.

evidence.quote: # Introduction Enabled by the increased accessibility of video-sharing platforms along with the advancement of networking and storage technology, a vast amount of new content becomes available on the web daily.

background_setup.summary: With this huge number of contents, Video Moment Retrieval (VMR) task, searching for a video moment suitable for a given query, has emerged as an essential problem .

evidence.quote: With this huge number of contents, Video Moment Retrieval (VMR) task, searching for a video moment suitable for a given query, has emerged as an essential problem [2, 6].

prior_work_summary.summary: On these benchmarks, we evaluate strong baseline VMR models, including state-of-the-art models, and demonstrate that significant overconfidence issues arise in the new scenario (MVMR).

evidence.quote: On these benchmarks, we evaluate strong baseline VMR models, including state-of-the-art models, and demonstrate that significant overconfidence issues arise in the new scenario (MVMR).

prior_work_summary.summary: We demonstrate that our CroCs outperforms strong baselines significantly in the MVMR setting, and this result proves that informative sample-weighted constrastive learning successfully mitigates the misinformation overconfidence of a VMR model.

evidence.quote: We demonstrate that our CroCs outperforms strong baselines significantly in the MVMR setting, and this result proves that informative sample-weighted constrastive learning successfully mitigates the misinformation overconfidence of a VMR model.
